area_note: Extremely small, area-optimized core (~750-1000 LUTs). A 16-word (512-bit) buffer would be huge relative to the baseline core.
constraints: The PCPI coprocessor interface cannot access memory; it has no address or data buses.
Any memory operands must be explicitly loaded into GPRs by the core before being passed to a custom instruction.
A custom instruction can return at most one 32-bit value to the register file per invocation.
The core completely stalls until the coprocessor asserts pcpi_ready; pipelining for throughput inside the coprocessor is useless.
Internal state inside the coprocessor is possible, but feeding or draining it must be done 32 bits at a time via standard registers.
coprocessor: Pico Co-Processor Interface (PCPI). Provides pcpi_insn, pcpi_rs1, pcpi_rs2 and accepts pcpi_wr, pcpi_rd, pcpi_ready, pcpi_wait.
coprocessor_result: A single 32-bit register value returned via pcpi_rd when pcpi_wr is asserted.
custom_opcode_space: Any unassigned 32-bit opcode. Unrecognized opcodes trigger an internal trap which forwards the instruction directly to the PCPI interface.
evidence: picorv32/picorv32.v port list: PCPI ports include only instruction and register data, completely lacking memory signals.
picorv32/picorv32.v `cpu_state` parameters define a sequential state machine without pipeline stages.
picorv32/picorv32.v `instr_trap` logic intercepts CATCH_ILLINSN and forwards the instruction to PCPI.
picorv32/picorv32.v memory interface `mem_state` requires a minimum of 2 cycles to complete a word transfer (0->1->0).
existing_units: Barrel shifter (optional via BARREL_SHIFTER, otherwise sequential)
isa: RV32I or RV32IC with optional M extension (configurable via ENABLE_MUL, COMPRESSED_ISA)
memory_interface: Native valid/ready interface (mem_valid, mem_ready, mem_addr, mem_wdata, mem_wstrb, mem_rdata) mapped to AXI4-Lite or Wishbone wrappers.
microarchitecture: Multi-cycle, unpipelined state machine (states: fetch, ld_rs1, ld_rs2, exec, shift, stmem, ldmem). Instructions execute strictly sequentially.
name: PicoRV32
register_file: 16 or 32 registers (ENABLE_REGS_16_31), implemented as distributed or block RAM. Up to 2 read ports (ENABLE_REGS_DUALPORT).
